name: Youngosuchus
sum: Youngosuchus is a loricatan archosaur from the Middle Triassic of China, first described as an erythrosuchid.
wsnote: No body-length estimate is given in the sources consulted.
holotype: IVPP V 3239, a skeleton with a complete skull, cervical vertebrae, ribs, pectoral girdle and forelimbs.
biology: The sources consulted describe its classification and anatomy but give no direct evidence of diet or habits.
author: Sennikov 1985
